findings.message: the auth signing key is generated in-process and will not survive a restart
findings.remediation: Configure a persistent, externally managed signing key instead of a process-generated ephemeral key so issued tokens survive a restart.

findings.message: datasource "default" is bound to an in-memory store
findings.remediation: Bind the datasource to a durable, provisioned store instead of an in-memory or ephemeral one before promoting to production.

waivedBy.reason: staging bake still uses the in-memory store; tracked in PUT-1234

findings.message: the metrics endpoint is served over plaintext HTTP
findings.remediation: Require TLS/HTTPS for this endpoint; plaintext transport is not allowed under the production profile.
